purpose: Compute the exact selected-outcome flip infimum under a common relative L-infinity budget for the five positive guard thresholds and nonnegative entrywise mission cost coefficients, using existing saved-q decisions only.
scope: Fixed saved six-decimal posterior, generated candidate strings and order, mission flags, action support, fallback/escalation rule and action overheads. Cost entries may vary independently with abs(Cprime-C)<=epsilon*C and Cprime>=0. Positive thresholds satisfy abs(thetaprime-theta)<=epsilon*theta. This is a per-decision perturbation certificate; different decisions may have different attaining perturbations.
not_in_scope: Semantic weight changes followed by regeneration, changes to posterior/router, shared perturbations optimized for all missions at once, physical safety, or deployment generalization.
algorithm: Enumerate 32 rejection-atom truth patterns. Compute exact positive-threshold attainability and its infimum g. Apply guards to the fixed exposed candidates. Empty candidates use verified fallback or escalation. If the original winner is absent from a nonempty new list, its flip infimum is g. Otherwise minimize over admitted challengers the cost crossing c from B*max(0,1-epsilon)+H_b versus A*(1+epsilon)+H_a, preserving candidate tie order. Take max(g,c) within each pattern and the minimum across patterns; retain whether that minimum is attained.
arithmetic: Use exact integer numerators/denominators derived from saved decimal q, archived coefficient and overhead constants. Verify all int64 cross-product bounds before comparison. Zero evidence makes the opposite positive-threshold atom unreachable. Epsilon above one clips reduced cost rows to zero. Infimum and attainment are reported separately.

validation.all_rows: Reconstruct nominal selection; check exact boundary feasibility and worst-case cost corners across all 32 patterns; compare boundary-flip existence with attainment. Check an interior radius for every row. Construct and replay a strictly-above-infimum witness for every finite result. Compare against the older sufficient joint certificate without overwriting it.
validation.scalar_spot: Independent fractions.Fraction implementation using interval breakpoints and explicit scalar guard logic. Fixed 256 random decisions (seed 609120701), first record of each mission, first eight cases in each of zero/infinite/radius-above-one/attained/not-attained categories, and the two existing worked examples; union without duplicate records.
validation.synthetic: Include zero cause evidence, zero coefficient rows, zero-radius strict ties, earlier/later candidate tie order, epsilon=1 clipping plateau, epsilon>1 crossing, open threshold boundary, closed boundary, empty-list fallback, escalation, and coincident guard/cost boundaries. Verify against independent Fraction solver.

reporting: All 54,000 rows, all 30 mission summaries, global descriptive distributions, finite/infinite and attained/unattained counts, exact closed-box stability at 10% and 20%, input hashes, validation receipts, and compact proposed manuscript/response text.
inference: Deterministic algebraic analysis of fixed records. No sampling-based hypothesis test, new raw p-value or change to the existing 78-test family.
preservation: Write only this new analysis directory and the assigned audit_fixes output directory; do not change canonical manuscript/reply or old scientific files. No API calls.
